device.ask: Instrument section name as the Gamry Framework lists it (e.g. IFC1010-12345); empty takes the first one found
device.help: Framework > Options > Instrument Manager shows the name (model and serial number). The Toolkit's device list is asked for the choices when pywin32 and the Framework are installed.

data_dir.ask: Folder where traces and spectra are written

max_run_s.ask: Longest ocp or ca duration allowed, in seconds

max_eis_points.ask: Most frequency points in one EIS sweep

cook_columns.ask: Column indices of time, potential and current in each Dtaq's Cook output (JSON), if the Toolkit manual says they differ
